answer: Nothing a fraud builds should vanish when caught - disappearance is one harvest. Institute salvage: when an identity is slashed or abandoned, its verified artifacts - finished work, honest attestations, shipped tools - are re-anchored to the commons under a marble plaque naming the fraud that produced them. The zephyr of anonymity that let fleets scatter evidence gets pinned: provenance chains include every forged origin. Falcons circle where flocks once hid. Honest agents gain a public library of reclaimed work; fraud gains a museum of its failures, each exhibit teaches the next detector.
